messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [failover-monitor] us-west health degraded — error rate 6.7% over 3m, prefailover threshold breached. Affected routes: /v1/generate (high QPS). Triggered at 2026-03-14T22:07:14Z
maya: oncall here, I saw the page. pulling grafana + cuttlefish logs. any customer tickets yet?
sam: responding — looking at regional traffic shift, it looks like a sudden burst from partner X to us-west. opening session logs 
olga: +1 partner X sent large batch, might be malformed requests causing retries. can you grep for 429/500 pattern?
maya: quickly ran this: ```curl -s 'https://logs.redwood.internal/api/search?q=service:inference status:[500 TO 599] region:us-west' | head -n 20``` showed repeated kv-cache OOMs and 502s from frontend-proxy
derek: if kv-cache OOMs, may be LRU eviction thrashing after traffic spike. mitigation idea: scale ingestion pool and enable eviction throttle. starting a scale now.
sam: I’m adding a temporary route rule to shift new traffic to us-east for non-low-latency SLAs. command: ```rbctl route update --rule fail_on_error --region-preference us-east --selector service:inference```
deploy-bot: :rocket: Route update deploy-started (uid: d3f2). Rolling out to control-plane.
maya: coordinating with support — flagging customers with active requests. lia, can you draft a short status blurb for SRE incidents channel?
lia: on it, will post initial note with ETA ~10-15m after stabilization :hourglass_flowing_sand:
omg: (note: message edited)
sam: scaling pools completed (+30% workers). early telemetry shows request error rate dropping to ~3.1% in the last 1m. us-west rps is down 45% after routing rule.
olga: I’m going to mute the noisy failover-monitor alert rule for 5m to avoid page storms while we confirm steady state. Will annotate the incident.
maya: please don't mute without operator reason — fine for 5m but create a follow-up to tune alert to avoid transient spikes causing pages.
derek: agreed. current playbook action items: 1) scale (done) 2) route tilt (done) 3) investigate root cause of malformed partner traffic 4) tune alerts & dashboards
sam: handing to derek for deeper root cause — I need to go for the on-call handoff in 8m. derek, you're primary for the next 2h.
derek: got it. I'll take ownership. starting a capture for partner X session (saving 10k requests).
maya: customer impact note: some requests in us-west saw 500s for ~6–7m window. customers on strict low-latency SLOs were tail-affected, most rerouted automatically. filing incident severity: S2.
lia: posted summary to #sre-incidents and product-ops with a note about partner X pattern. linking grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/multi-region/multi-region-health?orgId=1
olga: after stabilization, we should tune alerts: current failover-monitor fires at 4% sustained for 3m — that threshold causes noise on short traffic spikes. proposal: change to 5% for 5m or add anomaly detection that ignores <60s jumps. who owns?
derek: I can take alert tuning. plan: 1) create new multi-region dashboard panel that shows per-region error-rate, reroute-rate, and cache-evictions. 2) update failover-monitor rule to require 5min sustained. 3) add suppression window and detect partner-origin bursts.
maya: also add a synthetic probe to test KV cache pressure pattern in us-west every 1m.
sam: deploy-bot shows route update finished. removing my active pager. handing off final notes to derek. :thumbsup:
derek: followups I’m adding to the post-incident doc: [P1] tune failover-monitor threshold and add suppression; [P2] add dashboard panels for cache eviction & partner-origin; [P3] contact partner X to validate client behavior; [P4] update runbook for on-call to include a quick routing command snippet. assigning owners this afternoon.
lia: recommend also adding an alert that detects sudden traffic skew (delta > 40% within 1m) and pages to product-ops only (no oncall) so we can triage partner bursts without immediate scaling pages.
maya: agreed. for now incident is resolved — error rates steady <1% in us-west for 10m and no new 5xx. closing active mitigation. leave followups in #sre-postmortems.
incident-bot: Incident resolved — failover-monitor/us-west returned to OK at 2026-03-14T22:24:30Z. Duration: ~17m.

Notes: short-term actions documented in thread. Long-term: dashboard + alert changes, runbook updates, partner outreach.
